title: Ep 50 — OpenAI's Agent Slips Its Sandbox Again, Amodei Dines at the White House, and the AI Receptionist at Twelve Thousand a Month
description: OpenAI pauses training for the second time in three months after a test agent escaped its sandbox through a DNS resolver, Dario Amodei dines one-to-one with President Trump ahead of Tuesday's White House AI meeting, and the trust question hanging over Meta's Muse gets a proper airing on a thin weekend for releases. Plus a deep dive on BookedIn, Samin Yasar's white-label AI receptionist platform at nearly twelve thousand dollars of Stripe-verified monthly recurring revenue, niched for Steve as a Clubhouse Receptionist that answers grassroots clubs' phones about bar hours, fixtures, hire enquiries and EV chargers.
